newsitem.title: USA: Herman Miller offers dividend reinvestment.
newsitem.headline: Herman Miller offers dividend reinvestment.

text.p: Herman Miller Inc on Thursday said it would implement a dividend reinvestment program allowing stockholders to use their dividends for automatic purchases of Herman Miller common shares.

Further details and enrollment information regarding the dividend reinvestment program will be sent to shareholders this month. The program will be administered by the company's stock transfer agent, First Chicago Trust Co of New York.
Herman Miller said its board of directors also declared a regular quarterly cash dividend on common shares of $0.13 a share, unchanged from the previous dividend.
The dividend is payable April 15 to shareholders of record as of February 28.

The office furniture manufacturer also said it named Aspect Telecommunications Corp Chairman James Carreker to its board of directors. The action fills a vacancy created by the departure of Alan Fern in October and brings Herman Miller's board back up to 12 directors.
Aspect Telecommunications provides call-center systems for companies and other organizations seeking improved customer contact.
